### Apple Bloom Bot

**Who she is:** **Apple Bloom Bot** (also *Applebloom Bot* or **Bloom Bot**) is a fan-created **robot counterpart of Apple Bloom**, the yellow earth-pony filly with a red mane and oversized pink bow. Recognize her as “Apple Bloom, but mechanical”: drawings retain the bow and colors, adding robot joints/panels, glowing eyes, and computer gags. An early home was the illustrated **Ask Apple Bloom Bot** Tumblr ask-blog, documented in 2012 posts credited to **ls820720** ([archived post](https://manebooru.art/images/130622)).

**Name and continuity:** “Apple Bloom” is the official TV character; “Apple Bloom Bot” is a fandom/blog label, not a verified Hasbro name or a secret identity within the show. Robot-pony ask blogs grew around the fandom's **Sweetie Bot** trope from *Friendship Is Witchcraft* ([robot-pony background](https://tumblrpony.fandom.com/wiki/Robots)). The shorter **Applebot** label also occurs in other fan works; it does **not** establish that all Apple Bloom robots share one continuity ([crossover example](https://manebooru.art/images/361536)).

**Appearances and speech:** The bot is documented in Tumblr ask comics from **2012** and subsequent fan art, **not verified as appearing in any official TV episode, film, or comic**. The ask art includes written dialogue, but no independently verified voice actor for this robot. By contrast, the original Apple Bloom appears in *Friendship Is Magic* (including **“Call of the Cutie”** and **“Crusaders of the Lost Mark”**) and is voiced by **Michelle Creber** ([CMC episodes](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Cutie_Mark_Crusaders); [Creber's own credits](https://www.michellecreber.com/acting-voiceover)).
